fullText.simplified:
第11章、他们爱我

    三天后，高尔醒了。
    他还没有死，但他躺在床底，就像只大大的死甲虫。
    背很疼，高尔爬不动了。那个娃娃也还在地上。高尔看着它，看着它，一直看着它。
天黑了，高尔没有动。天亮了，高尔还没有动。
    门开了一点儿，碟子被推进来，还是妹妹，还是一小块面包。高尔一点儿都不想动，也一点儿都不想吃。
    晚上，黑黑的房间里，娃娃问高尔：“还疼吗？”
    高尔没有力气回答。
    娃娃又问：“他们真的爱你吗？”
    高尔还是没有回答，但是过了一会儿，他说：“他们爱我。”
    时间开始变慢，每天都像一年那样长。高尔的背一直在疼，他觉得自己生病了，但是没有医生。没关系，他不需要医生。
    有一天，房间外面突然变热闹了。
    家里来了三个人，是三个男人。他们说话的声音很大，好像害怕别人听不见他们的话，总是用最大的声音说话。
    高尔听了几天，慢慢听明白了。爸爸妈妈把房子租出去了，这三个男人是租客。以后，他们都住在这个房子里，每个月一号给爸爸租金。虽然租金不多，但能帮这个家。
    三个租客要住二楼的一个房间，妈妈和妹妹把那个房间里的家具全部搬了出来，因为租客带来了自己的家具。搬出来的家具放在哪儿呢？只有高尔的房间空着，妈妈和妹妹把家具搬进了高尔的房间。她们搬家具进来的时候，高尔没有动。他不想再吓到她们了，而且他一点儿力气都没有，也爬不动了。
    现在，房间里放满了家具，这儿已经不像是给人住的房间了。
    “那个房间没人住吗？”租客们问。
    “是的，没人住。”妹妹说。
fullText.traditional:
第11章、他們愛我

    三天後，高爾醒了。
    他還沒有死，但他躺在床底，就像隻大大的死甲蟲。
    背很疼，高爾爬不動了。那個娃娃也還在地上。高爾看著它，看著它，一直看著它。
天黑了，高爾沒有動。天亮了，高爾還沒有動。
    門開了一點兒，碟子被推進來，還是妹妹，還是一小塊麵包。高爾一點兒都不想動，也一點兒都不想吃。
    晚上，黑黑的房間裡，娃娃問高爾：“還疼嗎？”
    高爾沒有力氣回答。
    娃娃又問：“他們真的愛你嗎？”
    高爾還是沒有回答，但是過了一會兒，他說：“他們愛我。”
    時間開始變慢，每天都像一年那樣長。高爾的背一直在疼，他覺得自己生病了，但是沒有醫生。沒關係，他不需要醫生。
    有一天，房間外面突然變熱鬧了。
    家裡來了三個人，是三個男人。他們說話的聲音很大，好像害怕別人聽不見他們的話，總是用最大的聲音說話。
    高爾聽了幾天，慢慢聽明白了。爸爸媽媽把房子租出去了，這三個男人是租客。以後，他們都住在這個房子裡，每個月一號給爸爸租金。雖然租金不多，但能幫這個家。
    三個租客要住二樓的一個房間，媽媽和妹妹把那個房間裡的家具全部搬了出來，因為租客帶來了自己的家具。搬出來的家具放在哪兒呢？只有高爾的房間空著，媽媽和妹妹把家具搬進了高爾的房間。她們搬家具進來的時候，高爾沒有動。他不想再嚇到她們了，而且他一點兒力氣都沒有，也爬不動了。
    現在，房間裡放滿了家具，這兒已經不像是給人住的房間了。
    “那個房間沒人住嗎？”租客們問。
    “是的，沒人住。”妹妹說。

sentences.simplified: 三天后，高尔醒了。
sentences.traditional: 三天後，高爾醒了。
sentences.pinyin: sān tiān hòu gāo ěr xǐng le
sentences.english: Three days later, Gao Er woke up.

sentences.simplified: 他还没有死，但他躺在床底，就像只大大的死甲虫。
sentences.traditional: 他還沒有死，但他躺在床底，就像隻大大的死甲蟲。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái méi yǒu sǐ dàn tā tǎng zài chuáng dǐ jiù xiàng zhī dà dà de sǐ jiǎ chóng
sentences.english: He wasn’t dead yet, but he lay there under the bed, like a big, dead beetle.

sentences.simplified: 背很疼，高尔爬不动了。那个娃娃也还在地上。
sentences.traditional: 背很疼，高爾爬不動了。那個娃娃也還在地上。
sentences.pinyin: bèi hěn téng gāo ěr pá bú dòng le nà ge wá wá yě hái zài dì shang
sentences.english: His back hurt a lot. Gao Er couldn’t crawl anymore. The teddy bear was still on the floor.

sentences.simplified: 高尔看着它，看着它，一直看着它。
sentences.traditional: 高爾看著它，看著它，一直看著它。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr kàn zhe tā kàn zhe tā yì zhí kàn zhe tā
sentences.english: Gao Er looked at it, looked at it, and kept looking at it.

sentences.simplified: 天黑了，高尔没有动。天亮了，高尔还没有动。
sentences.traditional: 天黑了，高爾沒有動。天亮了，高爾還沒有動。
sentences.pinyin: tiān hēi le gāo ěr méi yǒu dòng tiān liàng le gāo ěr hái méi yǒu dòng
sentences.english: It was dark outside, and Gao Er hadn’t moved. It was dawn again, and Gao Er still hadn’t moved.

sentences.simplified: 门开了一点儿，碟子被推进来，还是妹妹，还是一小块面包。
sentences.traditional: 門開了一點兒，碟子被推進來，還是妹妹，還是一小塊麵包。
sentences.pinyin: mén kāi le yì diǎn'r dié zi bèi tuī jìn lái hái shi mèi mei hái shi yì xiǎo kuài miàn bāo
sentences.english: The door was opened a little, and a plate was pushed in. It was still his little sister, and it was still a small piece of bread.

sentences.simplified: 高尔一点儿都不想动，也一点儿都不想吃。
sentences.traditional: 高爾一點兒都不想動，也一點兒都不想吃。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yì diǎn'r dōu bù xiǎng dòng yě yì diǎn'r dōu bù xiǎng chī
sentences.english: Gao Er didn’t want to move at all, nor did he want to eat at all.

sentences.simplified: 晚上，黑黑的房间里，娃娃问高尔：“还疼吗？”
sentences.traditional: 晚上，黑黑的房間裡，娃娃問高爾：“還疼嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang hēi hēi de fáng jiān lǐ wá wá wèn gāo ěr hái téng ma
sentences.english: At night, in the dark room, the teddy bear asked Gao Er, “Does it still hurt?”

sentences.simplified: 高尔没有力气回答。
sentences.traditional: 高爾沒有力氣回答。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr méi yǒu lì qi huí dá
sentences.english: Gao Er didn’t have the strength to answer.

sentences.simplified: 娃娃又问：“他们真的爱你吗？”
sentences.traditional: 娃娃又問：“他們真的愛你嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: wá wá yòu wèn tā men zhēn de ài nǐ ma
sentences.english: The teddy bear asked again, “Do they really love you?”

sentences.simplified: 高尔还是没有回答，但是过了一会儿，他说：“他们爱我。”
sentences.traditional: 高爾還是沒有回答，但是過了一會兒，他說：“他們愛我。”
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr hái shi méi yǒu huí dá dàn shì guò le yí huì'r tā shuō tā men ài wǒ
sentences.english: Gao Er still didn’t answer. But after a while, he said, “They love me.”

sentences.simplified: 时间开始变慢，每天都像一年那样长。
sentences.traditional: 時間開始變慢，每天都像一年那樣長。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān kāi shǐ biàn màn měi tiān dōu xiàng yì nián nà yàng cháng
sentences.english: Time started to slow down. Every day felt as long as a year.

sentences.simplified: 高尔的背一直在疼，他觉得自己生病了，但是没有医生。
sentences.traditional: 高爾的背一直在疼，他覺得自己生病了，但是沒有醫生。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr de bèi yì zhí zài téng tā jué de zì jǐ shēng bìng le dàn shì méi yǒu yī shēng
sentences.english: Gao Er’s back was still hurting. He felt that he had gotten sick, but there was no doctor.

sentences.simplified: 没关系，他不需要医生。
sentences.traditional: 沒關係，他不需要醫生。
sentences.pinyin: méi guān xi tā bù xū yào yī shēng
sentences.english: Never mind, he didn’t need a doctor.

sentences.simplified: 有一天，房间外面突然变热闹了。
sentences.traditional: 有一天，房間外面突然變熱鬧了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān fáng jiān wài miàn tū rán biàn rè nao le
sentences.english: One day, there was suddenly commotion outside his room.

sentences.simplified: 家里来了三个人，是三个男人。
sentences.traditional: 家裡來了三個人，是三個男人。
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ lái le sān ge rén shì sān ge nán rén
sentences.english: Three people came to the house. It was three men.

sentences.simplified: 他们说话的声音很大，好像害怕别人听不见他们的话，
sentences.traditional: 他們說話的聲音很大，好像害怕別人聽不見他們的話，
sentences.pinyin: tā men shuō huà de shēng yīn hěn dà hǎo xiàng hài pà bié ren tīng bú jiàn tā men de huà
sentences.english: They spoke very loudly as if they were afraid that people couldn’t hear them, ..

sentences.simplified: 总是用最大的声音说话。
sentences.traditional: 總是用最大的聲音說話。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng shì yòng zuì dà de shēng yīn shuō huà
sentences.english: .. always talking in the loudest voice.

sentences.simplified: 高尔听了几天，慢慢听明白了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾聽了幾天，慢慢聽明白了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr tīng le jǐ tiān màn man tīng míng bai le
sentences.english: After listening for a few days, Gao Er gradually understood.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸妈妈把房子租出去了，这三个男人是租客。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸媽媽把房子租出去了，這三個男人是租客。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba mā ma bǎ fáng zi zū chū qù le zhè sān ge nán rén shì zū kè
sentences.english: His father and mother rented out the house, and these three men were the tenants.

sentences.simplified: 以后，他们都住在这个房子里，每个月一号给爸爸租金。
sentences.traditional: 以後，他們都住在這個房子裡，每個月一號給爸爸租金。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ hòu tā men dōu zhù zài zhè ge fáng zi lǐ měi ge yuè yī hào gěi bà ba zū jīn
sentences.english: From then on, they would all live in this house, and pay rent to Gao Er’s father on the first of each month.

sentences.simplified: 虽然租金不多，但能帮这个家。
sentences.traditional: 雖然租金不多，但能幫這個家。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zū jīn bù duō dàn néng bāng zhè ge jiā
sentences.english: Although the rent was not much, it could help the family.

sentences.simplified: 三个租客要住二楼的一个房间，
sentences.traditional: 三個租客要住二樓的一個房間，
sentences.pinyin: sān ge zū kè yào zhù èr lóu de yí ge fáng jiān
sentences.english: The three tenants were going to live in a room on the second floor.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈和妹妹把那个房间里的家具全部搬了出来，因为租客带来了自己的家具。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽和妹妹把那個房間裡的家具全部搬了出來，因為租客帶來了自己的家具。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma hé mèi mei bǎ nà ge fáng jiān lǐ de jiā jù quán bù bān le chu lai yīn wèi zū kè dài lái le zì jǐ de jiā jù
sentences.english: Gao Er’s mother and little sister moved all the furniture out of that room because the tenants brought their own furniture.

sentences.simplified: 搬出来的家具放在哪儿呢？
sentences.traditional: 搬出來的家具放在哪兒呢？
sentences.pinyin: bān chu lai de jiā jù fàng zài nǎ'r ne
sentences.english: Where would the furniture that was moved out go to?

sentences.simplified: 只有高尔的房间空着，妈妈和妹妹把家具搬进了高尔的房间。
sentences.traditional: 只有高爾的房間空著，媽媽和妹妹把家具搬進了高爾的房間。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu gāo ěr de fáng jiān kōng zhe mā ma hé mèi mei bǎ jiā jù bān jìn le gāo ěr de fáng jiān
sentences.english: Only Gao Er’s room was empty. His mother and little sister moved the furniture in Gao Er’s room.

sentences.simplified: 她们搬家具进来的时候，高尔没有动。
sentences.traditional: 她們搬家具進來的時候，高爾沒有動。
sentences.pinyin: tā men bān jiā jù jìn lái de shí hou gāo ěr méi yǒu dòng
sentences.english: When they were moving the furniture in, Gao Er did not move.

sentences.simplified: 他不想再吓到她们了，而且他一点儿力气都没有，也爬不动了。
sentences.traditional: 他不想再嚇到她們了，而且他一點兒力氣都沒有，也爬不動了。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù xiǎng zài xià dào tā men le ér qiě tā yì diǎn'r lì qi dōu méi yǒu yě pá bú dòng le
sentences.english: He didn’t want to scare them anymore, and besides, he had no strength left, and he was unable to crawl.

sentences.simplified: 现在，房间里放满了家具，这儿已经不像是给人住的房间了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，房間裡放滿了家具，這兒已經不像是給人住的房間了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài fáng jiān lǐ fàng mǎn le jiā jù zhè‘r yǐ jīng bú xiàng shì gěi rén zhù de fáng jiān le
sentences.english: Now, the room was filled with furniture. It didn’t even look like a room for people to live in anymore.

sentences.simplified: “那个房间没人住吗？”租客们问。
sentences.traditional: “那個房間沒人住嗎？”租客們問。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge fáng jiān méi rén zhù ma zū kè men wèn
sentences.english: “Is no one living in that room?” the tenants asked.

sentences.simplified: “是的，没人住。”妹妹说。
sentences.traditional: “是的，沒人住。”妹妹說。
sentences.pinyin: shì de méi rén zhù mèi mei shuō
sentences.english: “Yes, no one lives there,” Gao Er’s little sister said.

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: They Love Me
Three days later, Gao Er woke up.
He wasn’t dead yet, but he lay there under the bed, like a big, dead beetle.
His back hurt a lot. Gao Er couldn’t crawl anymore. The teddy bear was still on the floor.
Gao Er looked at it, looked at it, and kept looking at it.
It was dark outside, and Gao Er hadn’t moved. It was dawn again, and Gao Er still hadn’t moved.
The door was opened a little, and a plate was pushed in. It was still his little sister, and it was still a small piece of bread.
Gao Er didn’t want to move at all, nor did he want to eat at all.
At night, in the dark room, the teddy bear asked Gao Er, “Does it still hurt?”
Gao Er didn’t have the strength to answer.
The teddy bear asked again, “Do they really love you?”
Gao Er still didn’t answer. But after a while, he said, “They love me.”
Time started to slow down. Every day felt as long as a year.
Gao Er’s back was still hurting. He felt that he had gotten sick, but there was no doctor.
Never mind, he didn’t need a doctor.
One day, there was suddenly commotion outside his room.
Three people came to the house. It was three men.
They spoke very loudly as if they were afraid that people couldn’t hear them, ..
.. always talking in the loudest voice.
After listening for a few days, Gao Er gradually understood.
His father and mother rented out the house, and these three men were the tenants.
From then on, they would all live in this house, and pay rent to Gao Er’s father on the first of each month.
Although the rent was not much, it could help the family.
The three tenants were going to live in a room on the second floor.
Gao Er’s mother and little sister moved all the furniture out of that room because the tenants brought their own furniture.
Where would the furniture that was moved out go to?
Only Gao Er’s room was empty. His mother and little sister moved the furniture in Gao Er’s room.
When they were moving the furniture in, Gao Er did not move.
He didn’t want to scare them anymore, and besides, he had no strength left, and he was unable to crawl.
Now, the room was filled with furniture. It didn’t even look like a room for people to live in anymore.
“Is no one living in that room?” the tenants asked.
“Yes, no one lives there,” Gao Er’s little sister said.
